name: Abbey Falls
description: A stunning waterfall surrounded by lush coffee plantations and spice estates, perfect for nature lovers and photographers.

name: Raja's Seat
description: A scenic viewpoint offering breathtaking sunset views over the misty hills and valleys of Madikeri.

name: Madikeri Fort
description: A historic fort built in the 17th century with a museum showcasing the region's history and culture.

name: Omkareshwara Temple
description: A unique temple blending Gothic and Islamic architectural styles, dedicated to Lord Shiva.

name: Nisargadhama
description: A beautiful island formed by the river Cauvery, featuring bamboo groves, deer park, and elephant rides.

name: Tadiandamol Peak
description: The highest peak in Coorg, offering challenging treks and panoramic views of the Western Ghats.

name: Chelavara Falls
description: A hidden waterfall surrounded by dense forest, ideal for peaceful picnics and nature walks.

name: Bhagamandala Temple
description: A sacred pilgrimage site where three rivers meet, known for its tranquil atmosphere and religious significance.

name: Coffee Plantation Tour
description: Experience the local coffee culture with guided tours through aromatic plantations and tasting sessions.

name: Mallalli Falls
description: A spectacular waterfall cascading down rocky cliffs, surrounded by dense forest and trekking trails.

name: Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A protected forest reserve home to diverse flora and fauna, ideal for wildlife enthusiasts and trekkers.

name: Pushpagiri Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A biodiversity hotspot with rare species, offering trekking routes and bird watching opportunities.

name: Chelavara Falls Viewpoint
description: A lesser-known viewpoint providing stunning vistas of Chelavara Falls and surrounding greenery.

name: Madikeri Market
description: A bustling local market offering fresh produce, spices, handmade crafts, and Coorgi delicacies.

name: Iruppu Falls
description: A sacred waterfall located in a forested area, popular for its scenic beauty and religious significance.

name: Chelavara Coffee Estate Homestay
description: Experience authentic Coorg hospitality and coffee culture with a stay or visit to this charming estate homestay.

name: Kote Betta
description: A hilltop trek leading to ancient fort ruins, offering panoramic views of Madikeri and surrounding hills.

name: Chelavara Coffee Museum
description: A small museum showcasing the history and process of coffee cultivation in Coorg with interactive exhibits.

name: Mandalpatti Viewpoint
description: A scenic hilltop viewpoint accessible by jeep, offering sweeping views of the Western Ghats and valleys.

name: Chelavara Spice Plantation
description: Explore aromatic spice gardens with guided tours explaining the cultivation of pepper, cardamom, and vanilla.
